LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS: PRONUNCIATION

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.4: Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What do you do on different days of the week?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
2. respond to simple instructions correctly
3. appreciate the value of time for lifelong learning

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS: PRONUNCIATION
This lesson teaches Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation for Grade 4 ARABIC LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. respond to simple instructions correctly
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the value of time for lifelong learning
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation above.
2. Explain Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Phonological Awareness: Pronunciation important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What do you do on different days of the week?
2. Why are instructions important?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate pronunciation to outline the days of the week
2. respond to simple instructions correctly
3. appreciate the value of time for lifelong learning

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
